what: Read-only mainnet check: Jupiter GET /swap/v2/build (API key, never printed/committed) with the would-be Mag7 NAV vault authority PDA as taker; route instruction wrapped in keeper_swap and compiled with the vault LUT + Jupiter LUTs. Nothing signed or sent.
notes: The first MSFT build attempt returned HTTP 400 (upstream Raydium CLMM ZeroAmountSpecified); an immediate retry built normally. The keeper treats a failed build as no-route and falls back to v1 /swap-instructions.
Every route's only signer is the vault PDA, which the program signs via invoke_signed; route_v2 is on the on-chain allowlist.
keeperTick skips any route that exceeds 1232 bytes or 64 loaded accounts (fitsOnePacket).
